section_title: What helps a new life grow?

versions.label: BSB
paragraphs: 1 Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander. 2 Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation, 3 now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.

context_lines: The new birth and sincere love described at the end of chapter 1 now lead to putting away malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy and slander. These habits damage the very shared life the readers are called to cultivate.

The newborn’s appetite for milk gives the positive picture: crave nourishment that will bring growth in salvation. The word behind spiritual describes [what nourishes the soul](https://biblehub.com/greek/3050.htm). The image follows Peter’s description of the enduring word through which they have received new life.
The appeal rests on having tasted the Lord’s goodness, recalling [Psalm 34:8](https://biblehub.com/bsb/psalms/34.htm). Growth is a response to the One whose goodness they have begun to know.
common_interpretation_lines: [Wesley](https://wesley.nnu.edu/john-wesley/john-wesleys-notes-on-the-bible/notes-on-the-first-epistle-general-of-st-peter/) identifies the milk with God’s word nourishing faith, love and holiness. [Calvin](https://biblehub.com/commentaries/calvin/1_peter/2.htm) gives the picture a wider emphasis on the sincere, God-shaped life fitting the new birth. Both read the call as ongoing growth, rather than permission to remain immature.
god_plan_lines: [Psalm 34:1–10](https://biblehub.com/bsb/psalms/34.htm) joins tasting God’s goodness with refuge, praise and fear of the Lord. Peter draws the readers into that continuing life of dependence.

[Ephesians 2:19–22](https://biblehub.com/bsb/ephesians/2.htm) describes believers growing together into God’s dwelling place. The move from newborns to living stones in Peter’s next paragraph likewise places growth within a people being formed together.
current_position_lines: We don't have a position on this passage yet. When our study reaches a conclusion the text supports, it will appear here.
